# Implementation Planning

1. Derive tasks only from the approved architecture.
2. Assign T-n IDs, priority, files, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and verification work.
3. Topologically order tasks and identify blocked tasks and the critical path.
4. Add a unit/integration/browser test task where supported.
5. Write `docs/sdlc/<STORY-ID>/impl-plan.md` using the implementation-plan template.
